basic_details.short_information: The Bombay High Court, Original Side, Mumbai has issued a recruitment notification dated 1 August 2026 to prepare a selection list and waiting list of candidates for the post of Mali/Madatnis (Gardener/Helper) in its establishment. Interested and eligible candidates (male/female/other) can apply through the prescribed format by post. Below is a quick summary table. Register for Job Alerts

important_dates.raw: Notification Release Date: 1 August 2026 Last Date for Receipt of Application (by Speed Post): 20 August 2026, or reach the office by this date Practical Exam / Physical Test / Interview Dates: Not mentioned in the official notification — to be published later on the official Bombay High Court website | Applications sent through any mode other than Speed Post, or received after the last date, will not be considered.

application_fee.details: Application fee: Rs. 1,000/- (Rupees One Thousand only) for all categories. Fee must be submitted only as a Demand Draft (DD) drawn in favour of "BOMBAY HIGH COURT ORIGINAL SIDE". Applications without the fee will not be considered. The fee is non-refundable. Only Demand Draft is accepted — no other mode of fee payment (online, cash, postal order, etc.) is valid.

age_limit.details: Age will be calculated as on the date of publication of the notification (1 August 2026).

qualification.details: Candidates must fulfill all of the following conditions as on the last date of application. | The candidate must be a citizen of India. | Candidate must have passed at least the 4th standard (चौथी). Candidate must be able to read, write and speak Marathi. | Candidate must have a minimum of 3 years of experience in maintaining gardens, plants, trees and greenery in proper condition.

salary_details.details: The selected candidate will be placed in Pay Level S-3 (Rs. 16,600 - 52,400/-), along with Dearness Allowance (DA) and other allowances admissible as per rules. Initial appointment will be on a probationary basis for a period of 2 years.

selection_process: 1 Practical Exam (garden maintenance related) — minimum qualifying marks: 15 30

Candidates who fail to secure qualifying marks in the practical exam will be disqualified from the remaining process. The schedule for all these tests will be published from time to time on the official Bombay High Court website. Candidates must appear for the practical exam
physical fitness test and interview at their own expense. Only original photo ID proof (Voter ID
or Driving Licence) will be accepted at the time of the practical exam and interview.
how_to_apply: There is no online application portal mentioned in this notification. The application process is entirely offline, as described below:
Download/obtain the prescribed application format (Appendix "A") given with the notification.
Fill in all details accurately in your own handwriting/typed format as per the format.
Attach self-attested photocopies of all required documents (listed below).
Attach the Demand Draft of Rs. 1,000/- drawn in favour of "BOMBAY HIGH COURT ORIGINAL SIDE".
Write "Application for Mali/Madatnis Post" on the envelope.
Send the complete application only by Speed Post so that it reaches the address below on or before 20 August 2026:
Manager, Original Side, High Court, Mumbai Pay and Establishment Department, 2nd Floor, P.W.D. Building, Fort, Mumbai - 400032
Applications received through any mode other than Speed Post, or after the last date, will not be considered under any circumstances.
important_instructions: The application must be submitted strictly in the prescribed format (Appendix "A") attached with the notification. Candidates are responsible for filling in complete and accurate information in the application. Name, address, mobile number, email ID and date of birth must be entered exactly as per valid documents. Where marks are given in grades instead of percentage, candidates must obtain the marksheet with marks, total marks and percentage from the concerned school/board before applying offline, and submit it along with the application. If a candidate submits more than one application, only the last application will be considered for the fee already paid. Candidates called for interview must bring original documents for verification. The High Court administration reserves all rights regarding shortlisting, changing the exam pattern, postponing or cancelling the recruitment process, and no claim will be entertained in this regard. If any information given by a candidate is later found false or concealed, the candidature/appointment can be cancelled at any stage. Any attempt by a candidate to influence the selection committee directly or indirectly will lead to disqualification. Selected candidates will be appointed on probation for 2 years, during which services may be terminated at any time without notice or reason. This is an isolated post with no scope for future promotion; candidates should note this before applying. Merely applying does not entitle a candidate to an interview or appointment; higher educational qualification than prescribed will not be considered an advantage for selection.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Bombay High Court Mali/Madatnis Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for the application to reach the office by Speed Post is 20 August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Mali/Madatnis post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed at least the 4th standard and must be able to read, write and speak Marathi.

faq.question: Q3. Is prior experience required for this post?
faq.answer: Yes, a minimum of 3 years' experience in maintaining gardens, plants and trees is required.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for Bombay High Court Mali/Madatnis Recruitment?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 1,000/- for all categories, payable only through a Demand Draft in favour of "BOMBAY HIGH COURT ORIGINAL SIDE".

faq.question: Q5. Can I apply online for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No online application mode is mentioned in the notification. Applications must be sent offline by Speed Post to the address specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for the Mali/Madatnis post?
faq.answer: For open category, the age limit is 18–38 years; for backward class candidates, 18–43 years; existing court/government employees have no upper age limit.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary for the Mali/Madatnis post at Bombay High Court?
faq.answer: The post carries Pay Level S-3 (Rs. 16,600–52,400/-) along with Dearness Allowance and other admissible allowances.

faq.question: Q8. How many vacancies are there for the Mali/Madatnis post?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies currently, with 1 more post likely to become vacant within the next 2 years. A waiting list of 1 candidate will also be prepared.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for this post?
faq.answer: Selection is based on a Practical Exam (30 marks, qualifying marks 15), a Physical Fitness Test (10 marks), and a Personal Interview (10 marks), totalling 50 marks.
